summary: Proof-worth ownership for the closed privileged-capability current/target ledger, accepted Milestone 2 authority bindings, and sovereign first-vertical-slice design contract.

entries.contract: The static proof validates the exact ordered 32-row ledger against its structural JSON Schema and independently closes the two ADR 0044 owner bindings: immediate socket-peer audit-token/PID-generation evidence; ancestor proc-generation, UID, stable-edge, and code-identity evidence; discriminated daemon spawn evidence; content-free external-dispatch executable-resolution intent/finalization/receipt with transient-only raw script identity; explicit prior-generation transitions across operation, stream, tap, artifact, claim-set transaction, per-resource claim, multiplex broker, host barrier, and recovery; persisted artifact released/retained/removed and claim-set rollback/committed-handoff recovery dispositions; registry-revision-bound resource declarations plus canonical declaration/registered/selected/subscriber digest encoding; split all-or-nothing claim-set admission with exact current/pinned registry-declaration multiplex broker/subscriber CAS inputs, committed transaction binding, resulting publication facts, and bound claim-set/claim/broker transition guards; deterministic content-free conflict receipts; always-available boot-reconciling stop-all with typed no-false-cleanup results; immutable barrier snapshots across drain/recovery/reopen with snapshot-bound repeat, status, prior-generation, and reopen transition guards; four closed live transport, ordinary Canvas, status-item, and status-opened Canvas origins; generation-independent retained receipt replay with bounded eviction and expected-barrier CAS; and seven mandatory tap bounds with deterministic sampling stride, no source backpressure, bounded FIFO drain, typed expiry, exact counters, and bound open/expire transition guards. It closes exactly 19 M2 deliverables, 15 exit gates, 70 path refs, and 23 proof refs, including the frozen-v0/active-v1 external-command manifest cutover, exactly one listen-route spawn registration, v1-only Swift/help readers and wire-v2 browser/Work Record staging with current-aggregate rehydration, canonical proof-index and workflow reachability, authored NN-family targets 41-operation.json and 49-operation.json, both maintained API owners, the exact fifteen-form generation-bound operation/tap/artifact/barrier grammar, external-dispatch binding, and microphone-versus-legacy-output no-preemption contract. Independent semantic validators enforce those contracts, deterministic graph reachability, aggregate state-vector execution of exactly 12 outcome paths, normalized milestone ref closure, TypeScript/Toolkit reachability, proof attribution, and current-path truth. The command-surface proof fragment owns v0 freeze, v1 schema, generator, and broad-dispatch proofs; the operation-control fragment owns only operation-binding proofs. The proof still resolves exactly 101 functional bindings and 107 functional selectors, reverse-closes six fail-closed selectors, deep-closes all 15 non-absent TypeScript/Toolkit surfaces, classifies tracked regular-file production sources and searchable privilege metadata/descriptors, directly owns ScreenCaptureKit screen-output/capturesAudio=false/no-audio/no-public-recording truth, binds the seven-label canvas action vocabulary without execution, and verifies the portable 32-capability/96-symbol reviewed SDK snapshot without ambient SDK discovery.
entries.worth: This fails when accepted owner bindings drift; resource declaration or multiplex subscriber CAS loses current/pinned registry/declaration snapshot, committed-transaction, canonical digest/count/fanout closure; boot-time stop becomes unavailable or falsely claims cleanup; barrier snapshots mutate across close, recovery, repeat, or reopen; Canvas/status origins collapse or widen; any tap bound, sampling order, queue-stop, typed-expiry, or counter rule disappears; durable spawn data admits raw script identity/path/basename; frozen v0 bytes, v1-only reader and wire-v2 staging cutover, current-aggregate browser rehydration, Work Record v2 enforcement, one-listen registration, generator/schema proof ownership, canonical proof-index reachability, or workflow routing drifts; a prior-generation obligation disappears; released/retained artifact custody collapses to removed; claim rollback becomes succeeded; complete-set admission retains a partial claim; registered-set identity, bounded retained replay, or expected-barrier CAS drifts; M2 surface, gate, path, proof, CLI grammar, voice no-preemption, maintained API, or NN-owner closure changes; structural schema conditions admit contradictory data; an outcome execution path or milestone union is unresolved; an authored selector/package export/current path/source family drifts; ScreenCaptureKit audio truth changes; or compile proof is mislabeled live/TCC acceptance.
entries.guard: Structural JSON Schema validation, independent semantic validation, authored-manifest and package-export resolution, tracked regular-file production-source discovery plus bounded authored privilege-metadata/managed-descriptor search, reviewed SDK snapshot classification, and documentation/routing proof only; it does not run native, managed-live, daemon, browser, or TCC acceptance and performs no ./aos, build, package, install, generator, or live capability action.
